summary.text: Home of the Ajaokuta steel complex, with its headquarters at Egayin. A mix of Ebira, Igala and Bassa communities, around the industrial sites and along the river.

languageUse.text: Several languages and traditions are used side by side.

history.text: Home of the Ajaokuta Steel Mill, Nigeria’s largest, once called the bedrock of the country’s industrialisation; by 2017 it had still not produced a sheet of steel. A railway was planned from the Itakpe iron mines through Ajaokuta to Warri.
